claims.claim_text: "Development prioritised Gemini 3 Flash for cost efficiency, with periodic validation on Gemini 3 Pro. Preliminary experiments suggested that consensus voting depth and model capacity are partially substitutable: Flash with deep voting (10-of-30) achieved comparable F1 to Pro with shallow voting (2-of-5) at lower total cost. This informed our decision to optimise voting strategies on Flash before cross-model validation."
